However, the question specifically uses the phrase "Best Film" — and that is the exact category name used at the BAFTAs. The Golden Globes call theirs "Best Motion Picture – Drama" and the Oscars call theirs "Best Picture."

content.text: **The 77th BAFTA Film Awards** (February 18, 2024). The BAFTAs specifically award a "Best Film" category — and Oppenheimer won it there before going on to take Best Picture at the Oscars the following month. The Golden Globes happened earlier (January) but their category is called "Best Motion Picture – Drama," not "Best Film."
